Alutaguse vald.tiivistelma: Alutaguse Parish is a rural municipality in Ida-Viru County. The administrative centre is Iisaku.

Anija vald.tiivistelma: Anija Parish is a rural municipality in the eastern part of Harju County, Estonia.

Antsla vald.tiivistelma: Antsla Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Võru County.

Elva vald.tiivistelma: Elva is a rural parish in Tartu County, Estonia, with an area of 650 km2 (250 sq mi). As of 2017, it has a population of 14,241 inhabitants.

Haapsalu linn.tiivistelma: Haapsalu is an urban municipality of Estonia, in Lääne County. It comprises the town of Haapsalu and settlements of the former parish of Ridala.

Haljala vald.tiivistelma: Haljala Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Lääne-Viru County. The municipality got its current borders following the 2017 administrative reform when Vihula municipality was merged with Haljala municipality.

Harku vald.tiivistelma: Harku Parish is a rural municipality in Harju County, northern Estonia, located west and neighbouring the capital Tallinn. It occupies an area of 159.77 km2 (61.69 sq mi) and has a population of 19,128.

Hiiumaa vald.tiivistelma: Hiiumaa Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia on the island of Hiiumaa. Hiiumaa Parish was established by merging Emmaste Parish, Hiiu Parish, Käina Parish and Pühalepa Parish after the municipal elections held on 15 October 2017.

Häädemeeste vald.tiivistelma: Häädemeeste is a municipality located in Pärnu County of Estonia. Häädemeeste literally means "(place) of good men" in Estonian.

Järva vald.tiivistelma: Järva Parish is a municipality in Järva County, Estonia. It was created in 2017 as a merger of 6 municipalities: Albu Parish, Ambla Parish, Imavere Parish, Järva-Jaani Parish, Kareda Parish and Koigi Parish.

Jõelähtme vald.tiivistelma: Jõelähtme Parish is a municipality in Estonia. It was established in 1992 and is administratively part of the Harju County, in northwestern Estonia.

henkilot.kuvaus: Baltic German missionary and protestant martyr (1873-1896)

Jõgeva vald.tiivistelma: Jõgeva Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Jõgeva County. It has a population of 12,849 (2025) and an area of 1,039.66 km2 (401.41 sq mi), with a population density of 12.36/km2.

Kadrina vald.tiivistelma: Kadrina Parish is a rural municipality in Lääne-Viru County, northern Estonia. It covers an area of 329.26 km² and has a population of 4,629.

Kambja vald.tiivistelma: Kambja Parish is a rural municipality in Tartu County, Estonia.

Kanepi vald.tiivistelma: Kanepi Parish is a rural municipality in Estonia, located in Põlva County. It has a population of 4,662 and covers an area of 524.68 km2 (202.58 sq mi).

Kastre vald.tiivistelma: Kastre Parish is a rural municipality in Tartu County, Estonia.

Kehtna vald.tiivistelma: Kehtna Parish is a rural municipality in central Estonia. It is a part of Rapla County.

Keila linn.tiivistelma: Keila is a town and an urban municipality in Harju County in north-western Estonia, 25 km (16 mi) southwest of Tallinn. As of 2025, the town has a population of 11,024 inhabitants.

Kihnu vald.tiivistelma: Kihnu Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Pärnu County. The parish covers the 16.88 km² area of Kihnu island, making it one of the smallest parishes in Estonia.

Kiili vald.tiivistelma: Kiili Parish is a rural municipality of Harju County in northwestern Estonia, south of the national capital, Tallinn. Its population was 7,360 as of 1 January 2026 and its area is 100.4 km2 (38.8 mi2).

Kohila vald.tiivistelma: Kohila Parish is the northernmost municipality of Rapla County, Estonia. It has a population of 5,925 and an area of 230.20 km (143.04 mi).

Kohtla-Järve linn.tiivistelma: Kohtla-Järve is a city and municipality in Ida-Viru County, northeastern Estonia, founded in 1924 and incorporated as a town in 1946.

Kose vald.tiivistelma: Kose Parish is a rural municipality in northern Estonia. It is a part of Harju County.

Kuusalu vald.tiivistelma: Kuusalu Parish is a rural municipality in northern Estonia, in terms of territory the largest in Harju County. It united with the former Loksa Parish in 2005.

henkilot.kuvaus: Estonian organist, composer and music pedagogue (1914–1999)

Loksa linn.tiivistelma: Loksa is a town and municipality in Harju County, Estonia, best known for its shipping industry. Loksa is the northernmost town in Estonia.

Luunja vald.tiivistelma: Luunja Parish is a rural municipality in Tartu County, Estonia.

Lääne-Harju vald.tiivistelma: Lääne-Harju Parish is a rural municipality in northern Estonia. It is a part of Harju County.

Lääne-Nigula vald.tiivistelma: Lääne-Nigula Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Lääne County. It has a population of 6907 and an area of 1,449 km2 (559 sq mi).

Lääneranna vald.tiivistelma: Lääneranna Parish is a rural municipality in Pärnu County. It includes the town of Lihula.

Lüganuse vald.tiivistelma: Lüganuse Parish is a municipality of Ida-Viru County in northern Estonia. As of 1 January 2015, it had a population of 2,941.

Maardu linn.tiivistelma: Maardu is a town and a municipality in Harju County, Estonia. It is part of Tallinn metropolitan area, located about 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) east of the capital city.

Muhu vald.tiivistelma: Muhu Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Saare County. It consists of 52 villages with a total population of 2,142 and a total area of 208 km2 (80 sq mi).

Mulgi vald.tiivistelma: Mulgi Parish is a rural municipality in southern Estonia. It is a part of Viljandi County.

Mustvee vald.tiivistelma: Mustvee Parish is a rural municipality within Jõgeva County, in Estonia. It includes the town of Mustvee.

Märjamaa vald.tiivistelma: Märjamaa Parish is an Estonian municipality located in Rapla County. It had a population of 7,015 and an area of 1,164 km2 (336.54 mi2).

Narva linn.tiivistelma: Narva is a city and municipality in Estonia. It is located in Ida-Viru County, at the eastern extreme point of Estonia, on the west bank of the Narva river, which forms the Estonia–Russia international border.

Narva-Jõesuu linn.tiivistelma: Narva-Jõesuu is an urban municipality of Estonia, in Ida-Viru County. It comprises the town of Narva-Jõesuu, settlements of the former parish of Vaivara, and two former distant exclaves of the urban municipality of Kohtla-Järve.

Nõo vald.tiivistelma: Nõo Parish is a rural municipality in Tartu County, Estonia.

Otepää vald.tiivistelma: Otepää Parish is a rural municipality in Valga County, southern Estonia. It includes the town of Otepää, which is referred to as the "winter capital" of Estonia.

Paide linn.tiivistelma: Paide is an urban municipality of Estonia, in Järva County. It comprises the town of Paide and settlements of former parishes of Paide and Roosna-Alliku.

Peipsiääre vald.tiivistelma: Peipsiääre Parish is a rural municipality located in the Tartu County, Estonia. The municipality of Peipsiäere was formed as a result of the administrative reform on 23 October 2017.

Pärnu linn.tiivistelma: Pärnu is an urban municipality of Estonia, in Pärnu County. It comprises the town of Pärnu and settlements of former parishes of Audru, Paikuse and Tõstamaa.

Põhja-Sakala vald.tiivistelma: Põhja-Sakala Parish is a rural municipality in Viljandi County.

Põltsamaa vald.tiivistelma: Põltsamaa is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Jõgeva County. It has a population of 2722 (2001) and an area of 416.9 km2 (161.0 mi2).

Põlva vald.tiivistelma: Põlva Parish is a rural municipality in Põlva County, southeastern Estonia.

Raasiku vald.tiivistelma: Raasiku Parish in located in Harju County, southeast of Tallinn. The primary highway serving the parish is the Jüri-Aruküla-Raasiku-Jägala road.

Rae vald.tiivistelma: Rae Parish is a rural municipality in northern Estonia. It is a part of Harju County.

Rakvere linn.tiivistelma: Rakvere is the administrative center, or county seat, of Lääne-Viru County in northern Estonia, about 100 km southeast of Tallinn and 20 km south of the Gulf of Finland and the Baltic Sea.

henkilot.kuvaus: Estonian amateur wrestler, judoka and sumo wrestler (born 1992)

Rakvere vald.tiivistelma: Rakvere Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Lääne-Viru County. Rakvere municipality surrounds the city of Rakvere and is located in north east Estonia.

Rapla vald.tiivistelma: Rapla Parish is an Estonian municipality located in Rapla County. It has a population of 13,193 and an area of 859 km2.

Ruhnu vald.tiivistelma: Ruhnu Parish is a municipality in Saare County, Estonia. It encompasses the island of Ruhnu in the Gulf of Riga, together with a number of uninhabited islets.

Räpina vald.tiivistelma: Räpina Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Põlva County. It has a population of 4,611 and an area of 265.93 km2.

Rõuge vald.tiivistelma: Rõuge Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Võru County. In 2019, it had a population of 5,427 and an area of 933 km2.

Saarde vald.tiivistelma: Saarde is a municipality located in Pärnu County, one of the 15 counties of Estonia.

Saaremaa vald.tiivistelma: Saaremaa Parish, also known as Saaremaa Municipality, is a municipality in Saare County in western Estonia. It is the largest municipality by land area and largest rural municipality – or parish – by population in Estonia.

Saku vald.tiivistelma: Saku Parish is a rural municipality in Harju County, north-western Estonia.

Saue vald.tiivistelma: Saue Parish is a rural municipality in Harju County, north-western Estonia.

Setomaa vald.tiivistelma: Setomaa Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Võru County. Setomaa Parish was formed in 2017 during the administrative reform by merging Mikitamäe, Meremäe and Värska parishes and some parts of Misso parish.

Sillamäe linn.tiivistelma: Sillamäe is a town in Ida-Viru County in the northeastern part of Estonia, on the southern coast of the Gulf of Finland. It has a population of 11,824 and covers an area of 12.15 km2.

Tallinn.tiivistelma: Tallinn is the capital and largest city of Estonia. Located on a bay in northern Estonia, on the shore of the Gulf of Finland of the Baltic Sea, it has a population of 452,563 as of 2026, making it the third most-populous city in the Baltics.

Tapa vald.tiivistelma: Tapa Parish is a rural municipality in Lääne-Viru County in northern Estonia.

Tartu linn.tiivistelma: Tartu is an urban municipality of Estonia, in Tartu County. It consists of the city of Tartu, as well as the former Tähtvere Parish bordering the city in the north-west.

Tartu vald.tiivistelma: Tartu Parish is a rural municipality in Tartu County, Estonia. It has a population of 12,725 and covers an area of 742 km2 (286 sq mi).

Toila vald.tiivistelma: Toila Parish was an Estonian municipality located in Ida-Viru County. It had a population of 4,735 (2019) and an area of 266 km².

Tõrva vald.tiivistelma: Tõrva Parish is a rural municipality in Valga County. It includes the town of Tõrva.

Türi vald.tiivistelma: Türi Parish is a rural municipality in Järva County, Estonia.

Valga vald.tiivistelma: Valga Parish is a rural municipality in Valga County. It includes the town of Valga.

Viimsi vald.tiivistelma: Viimsi Parish is a rural municipality in Northern Estonia, situated on the southern coast of the Gulf of Finland and neighbouring the capital Tallinn. With a population of 22,935, Viimsi is considered to be the wealthiest municipality in Estonia.

Viljandi linn.tiivistelma: Viljandi is a city and municipality in southern Estonia with a population of 17,000 in 2026. It is the capital of Viljandi County and is geographically located between two major Estonian cities, Pärnu and Tartu.

Viljandi vald.tiivistelma: Viljandi Parish is a rural municipality of Viljandi County, Estonia. It is located around the town of Viljandi, but does not include it.

Vinni vald.tiivistelma: Vinni Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Lääne-Viru County. It has a population of 5,630 and an area of 486.65 km2 (187.90 sq mi).

Viru-Nigula vald.tiivistelma: Viru-Nigula Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Lääne-Viru County. It has a population of 1,293 and an area of 312 km2 (120 sq mi).

Vormsi vald.tiivistelma: Vormsi Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Lääne County. It covers the area of Vormsi island.

Väike-Maarja vald.tiivistelma: Väike-Maarja Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Lääne-Viru County. It has a population of 5,421 and an area of 457.39 km².

Võru linn.tiivistelma: Võru is a town and a municipality in south-eastern Estonia. It is the center of both the Võru County and the Võru Parish although the town itself is not part of the Võru Parish but forms a separate urban municipality.

Võru vald.tiivistelma: Võru Parish is a rural municipality of Estonia, in Võru County. It has a population of 4,770 and an area of 202.23 km2.
